title: Detour Delay Referral Caps by Fare (Wayfare Rides)
content:
**Cap schedule.** The cap on a detour delay referral on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** follows the trip's fare charge amount, as booked: a fare charge of at least the large referral fare of $50.00 takes the large referral cap of $20.00; one of at least the mid referral fare of $25.00 but below $50.00 takes the mid referral cap of $12.00; for a smaller fare charge the referral cap is not raised.

| Fare charge amount | Referral cap |
|---|---|
| $50.00 or more | $20.00 |
| at least $25.00, below $50.00 | $12.00 |
| below $25.00 | not raised |

## Threshold checks (hypothetical fare charges)

| Fare charge | Cap |
|---|---|
| $24.99 | not raised |
| $25.00 | $12.00 |
| $49.99 | $12.00 |
| $50.00 | $20.00 |
